description: Na₃BeTh₁₀F₄₅ crystallizes in the tetragonal P4₂/ncm space group. There are two inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to eight F atoms. There are a spread of Na-F bond distances ranging from 2.40-2.60 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to six F atoms. There are a spread of Na-F bond distances ranging from 2.23-2.79 Å. Be is bonded in a tetrahedral geometry to four equivalent F atoms. All Be-F bond lengths are 1.57 Å. There are three inequivalent Th sites. In the first Th site, Th is bonded in a 9-coordinate geometry to nine F atoms. There are a spread of Th-F bond distances ranging from 2.33-2.66 Å. In the second Th site, Th is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to eight F atoms. There are a spread of Th-F bond distances ranging from 2.30-2.41 Å. In the third Th site, Th is bonded in a 9-coordinate geometry to nine F atoms. There are a spread of Th-F bond distances ranging from 2.32-2.51 Å. There are sixteen inequivalent F sites. In the first F site, F is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to one Na and two Th atoms. In the second F site, F is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to one Na and two Th atoms. In the third F site, F is bonded in a bent 150 degrees geometry to two Th atoms. In the fourth F site, F is bonded in a trigonal non-coplanar geometry to one Na and two equivalent Th atoms. In the fifth F site, F is bonded in a bent 150 degrees geometry to two Th atoms. In the sixth F site, F is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to one Na and two equivalent Th atoms. In the seventh F site, F is bonded in a 2-coordinate geometry to one Na and one Th atom. In the eighth F site, F is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to one Be and one Th atom. In the ninth F site, F is bonded in a trigonal non-coplanar geometry to three Th atoms. In the tenth F site, F is bonded in a bent 150 degrees geometry to two equivalent Th atoms. In the eleventh F site, F is bonded in a distorted trigonal non-coplanar geometry to one Na and two Th atoms. In the twelfth F site, F is bonded in a distorted linear geometry to two equivalent Th atoms. In the thirteenth F site, F is bonded in a bent 150 degrees geometry to two equivalent Th atoms. In the fourteenth F site, F is bonded in a bent 150 degrees geometry to two equivalent Th atoms. In the fifteenth F site, F is bonded in a distorted rectangular see-saw-like geometry to two equivalent Na and two equivalent Th atoms. In the sixteenth F site, F is bonded in a bent 150 degrees geometry to two Th atoms.
